Physical.name: Mortal Blow
Physical.description:
Attacks the target's vital points with 73 Power added to P. Atk.
Over-hit is possible.

Physical.name: Double Shot
Physical.description:
Supplements P. Atk. with 1476 Power to fire 2 arrows in rapid succession.
Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.

Physical.name: Burst Shot
Physical.description:
Inflicts physical damage around enemy. Power: 1050 in PvP, 1365 in PvE.
Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.

Physical.name: Unlock
Physical.description: Opens Lv. 1 doors with a 30% chance. Also opens treasure chests with a 100% chance.

Physical.name: Lethal Shot
Physical.description:
Inflicts physical damage. Power: 5798.
Burns 10% of current enemy's CP 3 times over 10 sec.
Ignores Shield Defence.
Half-kill, Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.

Physical.name: Multiple Shot
Physical.description:
Inflicts physical damage on multiple enemies. Power: 4270.
Ignores Shield Defence.
Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.

Physical.name: Death Shot
Physical.description:
Inflicts physical damage. Power: 11440.
Ignores Shield Defence.
Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.

Magical.name: Poison Recovery
Magical.description: Cures the user of minor poisoning.

Magical.name: Elemental Heal
Magical.description: Restores all party members' HP with 71 Power.

Buff.name: Ultimate Evasion

Evasion +20
Chance to evade P./M. Skills +25%
Resistance to buff-canceling attacks +80%.

Buff.name: Spirit Barrier
Buff.description: Increases the user's M. Def. by 10%.

Buff.name: Soul of Sagittarius
Buff.description: Increases the user's Max MP by 12%.

With Bow:
P. Atk. +65
Atk. Spd. +20%
P. Skills Reuse Time -5%

Debuff.name: Charm
Debuff.description: Decreases an enemy's aggression toward the user by 132.

Debuff.name: Bleed
Debuff.description: Decreases an enemy's Speed by 20%, and inflicts Bleed, causing them to lose 25 HP every second. Inflicts minor damage based on walked distance.

Debuff.name: Stun Shot
Debuff.description:
Supplements the user's P. Atk. with 344 Power to fire an arrow that stuns an enemy.
Over-hit and target cancel are possible.

Debuff.name: Hamstring Shot
Debuff.description:
Supplements the user's P. Atk. with 406 Power to decrease an enemy's Speed by 30%.
Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.

Debuff.name: Mark of Hunter
Debuff.description:
Resistance to Bow attacks -8%.
If not removed, reduces Resistance to Bow attacks by another 1%.
Effect reapplies up to 4 times with maximum Resistance to Bow attacks -12%.
Duration of each effect: 3 sec.

Toggle.name: Accuracy
Toggle.description: Accuracy +3. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.

Toggle.name: Vicious Stance
Toggle.description: Increases Critical Damages by 35. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level. Just for a Blow skills.

Toggle.name: Focus Skill Mastery
Toggle.description:
Skill Mastery Rate +10%.
Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.

Toggle.name: Block Buff
Toggle.description:
Switchable skill.
Your character cannot receive external buff effects.

P. Skills and Rhythms Reuse Time -6%

Evasion +2.

Reuse time: 60 sec.

Special.name: Counter Dash
Special.description:

Speed in Light Armor +10
Speed in Heavy and Robe Armor +8.
Duration: 30 sec.
Reuse time: 60 sec.
